sk = num(r.get("sacks_suffered") if r.get("sacks_suffered") not in (None, "") else r.get("sacks")) if att < 1: continue pid = r.get("player_id"); qname[pid] = r.get("player_display_name") or r.get("player_name") qdb[pid] += wgt * (att + sk); qepa[pid] += wgt * num(r.get("passing_epa")) if att >= 10: qg[pid] += 1 tot_db = sum(qdb.values()); lg = (sum(qepa.values()) / tot_db) if tot_db else 0.0 PRIOR = 250.0 qi = [{"Player": qname[q], "Dropbacks": round(qdb[q]), "Games": qg[q], "EPAperDB": round(qepa[q] / qdb[q], 4), "Index": round((qepa[q] + PRIOR * lg) / (qdb[q] + PRIOR), 4), "LeagueMean": round(lg, 4)} for q in qdb if qdb[q] >= 30] def write(name, rows_, cols): ''' assert old in s;
